newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India shares slip in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India shares slip in quiet trade.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts finished another slow day easier on Monday, amid few fresh factors and mild profit-taking, dealers said.
They said the falls were on the back of low volumes and expected support to appear on any further declines.
A trader said volumes were limited to market makers as investors showed little interest.
"The volumes have been pretty low but if prices come down much more the buyers will be in again," a trader said.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed 1.22 points lower at 87.91, or 1.37 percent, with the premium over the local market at 25.69 percent from 27.87 percent.
Bombay's benchmark index rose 6.16 points to 4.089.20.
Reliance attracted some profit taking following recent gains, shedding $1.05 to $22/23. State Bank of India fell 90 cents to $25/26.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index closed down 1.39 points, or 1.78 percent, at 76.76 points, a premium of 43.08 percent over the local market.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index finished 2.78 points firmer, a rise of 2.22 percent, at 128.30, representing a discount to the local market of 2.90 percent.
